highlights: Green Lion Signature Pro Smart Watch

The Green Lion Signature Pro Smart Watch is a chic and super cool accessory that comes with many great features. It's crafted with a Alloy Vacuum Plating case, and with the lightweight design (just 60g), this watch has become so comfortable to wear. The Green Lion Signature Pro Smart Watch has a lot more than just basic functions; it goes with features like vibration support, 1GB storage for your favorite apps and music, and multiple NFC capabilities for easy payments. There are also sport modes and sleep monitoring to help you being aware of your health status.
1.43" Super Amoled Screen display with a high-resolution at 466*466-pixel gives you the best vision to stay informed all the time.
Another useful feature is the 24-hour auto tracking that checks and monitors your heart rate. With Bluetooth 5.0 connectivity, you can stay connected and synced easily.
This watch is equipped with a long-lasting 210mAh Lithium-ion Polymer Battery, meaning that you can rely on it to stay charged for days just on a single charge, which takes 150 minutes to get full.
